blocks.en: Planetary Industry (PI) (previously called Planetary Interaction or Planetary Production (PP)), is a type of Industry that allows pilots to create industrial colonies on just about any planet in the EVE universe. We will use the two terms and the corresponding abbreviations interchangeably for now.
blocks.zh: 行星开发（Planetary Industry）（PI）（以前称为行星交互（Planetary Interaction）或行星生产（Planetary Production）（PP）），是一种工业活动，让飞行员可以在 EVE 宇宙中几乎任何一颗行星上建立工业殖民地。目前我们会混用这两种叫法及对应的缩写。

blocks.en: The aim of this is producing goods from raw materials extracted from the planet. Planetary Industry can produce a range of commodities which can be used in blueprints to create POS Structures and Fuel Blocks, Sovereignty structures, Boosters, Nanite Repair Paste, and T2 components.
blocks.zh: 行星开发的目的，是用从行星上提取的原材料生产商品。行星开发可以产出一系列商品，这些商品可在蓝图中用于制造POS 建筑和燃料块、主权建筑、增效剂、纳米体修复粘合剂以及T2 组件。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 简介

blocks.en: To engage in Planetary Industry, pilots need to purchase the correct Command Center for their chosen planet from the market. There are eight types of Command Centers (one for each type of planet). Once the correct Command Center is placed on a planet other facilities such as extractors and processors may be placed. As the correct Command Center needs to be deployed before beginning any extraction, it is good to survey and select your chosen planet(s) prior to purchase.
blocks.zh: 要从事行星开发，飞行员需要在市场上为所选行星购买对应的指挥中心。指挥中心共有八种（每种行星一种）。在行星上放置正确的指挥中心后，才能放置采集器、处理设施等其他设施。由于开始任何采集之前都必须先部署正确的指挥中心，最好在购买之前先勘测并选定你的行星。

blocks.en: Once raw materials have been collected, they can be processed on-planet or on a planet dedicated to manufacturing into basic or advanced goods, taken off-planet for station-based processing into a variety of products used in space, or sold. Material is removed from a planet either by launches from the Command Center or through a planetary Customs Office that charges a tax. Material can be brought down to a planet only through the Customs Office, at a reduced taxation rate.
blocks.zh: 收集到原材料后，可以在本行星或专门用于制造的行星上把它们加工成基础或高级商品，也可以运离行星，在空间站中加工成各种太空中使用的产品，或者直接出售。物资离开行星有两种方式：从指挥中心发射，或者通过收税的行星海关办公室。物资只能通过海关办公室运到行星上，税率较低。

blocks.en: Selling the materials and/or goods provides a source of income to players who invest in the necessary skills. You can keep a colony running with a little attention once a day, more often if you want to optimize, or less often if you'd just like to coast along and check on your assets once in a while.
blocks.zh: 对投入了必要技能的玩家来说，出售这些材料和/或商品是一项收入来源。殖民地只需每天稍微照看一下就能保持运转；想优化的话可以更频繁地打理，想轻松一点的话也可以偶尔才看看你的资产。

blocks.en: Currently the facilities on the planet are invulnerable, however you may indirectly compete with others for nearby resources. Retrieving the valuable products from planets is another matter altogether, as pilots experience the typical risks of transporting valuables.
blocks.zh: 目前行星上的设施是无敌的，不过你可能会和其他人间接争夺附近的资源。把贵重产品从行星上运回来则完全是另一回事，飞行员会面临运输贵重物品的常见风险。

blocks.zh: 另外，破碎星系中无法进行行星开发。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Skills!
blocks.zh: 技能！

blocks.en: None of the skills related to PI are technically required to try it out. However, you'll be limited to a single Command Center (and thus a single planet) of the lowest quality until you do some initial training. Additionally, unless you want to place your extractors blind, you'll want to train Remote Sensing to at least level I. Thus, you're most likely to get the best use out of training that first, then Interplanetary Consolidation and Command Center Upgrades.
blocks.zh: 严格来说，尝试行星开发并不需要任何行星开发相关技能。不过在完成初步训练之前，你只能使用一个最低品质的指挥中心（也就只能开发一颗行星）。另外，除非你想盲放采集器，否则至少要把遥测感应技术练到 I 级。因此，最好先练这个，再练行星统筹管理学和指挥中心升级理论。

blocks.en: Click each skill link for more details
blocks.zh: 点击各技能链接查看详情

en: (Planet Management) Interplanetary Consolidation - Increases the number of planets you can install command centers on up to 6
(Planet Management) Command Center Upgrades - Allows you to use better quality command centers. This in turn allow you to increase the number of installations on the planet.

(Planet Management) Remote Sensing - Allows a player to scan planets remotely. Each skill level increases the distance at which it's possible to scan. Requires level 1 to scan at all, so train to level 1 before starting PI.

(Planet Management) Planetology - Increases the resolution when scanning planets for resources. This is visible in the number of gradient bands displayed on the planet's surface when scanning for a resource.

(Planet Management) Advanced Planetology - Increases the precision when scanning planets for resources. Note that Planetology allows you to see more details while Advanced Planetology allows you to have a more accurate idea of where the resources are located. See the skills page for more info.

(Trade) Customs Code Expertise - Reduces the NPC tax rate of Player Owned Customs Offices (POCOs) in high sec. It does NOT, however, have any effect on tax rates with NPC customs offices either inside or outside of high sec.
zh: （行星管理）行星统筹管理学——增加可安装指挥中心的行星数量，最多 6 颗
（行星管理）指挥中心升级理论——让你可以使用更高品质的指挥中心，从而增加行星上可建设施的数量。
（行星管理）遥测感应技术——让玩家可以远程扫描行星。每级技能都会增加可扫描的距离。至少要 1 级才能扫描，所以开始行星开发前先练到 1 级。
（行星管理）行星学——提高扫描行星资源时的分辨率，体现在扫描某种资源时行星表面显示的渐变色带数量上。
（行星管理）高级行星学——提高扫描行星资源时的精度。注意，行星学让你看到更多细节，而高级行星学让你更准确地了解资源的位置。更多信息请见技能页面。
（贸易学）海关操作专业理论——降低高安中玩家海关办公室（POCO）的 NPC 税率。但它对高安内外的 NPC 海关办公室税率并没有任何影响。

blocks.en: Planets
blocks.zh: 行星

blocks.en: All these planets are Yours
blocks.zh: 这些行星全都是你的

blocks.en: Main article: Planets
blocks.zh: 主条目：行星

blocks.en: Planets come in all sorts of shapes and sizes and accordingly provide different materials. Each planet provides five resources, but a few unique resources each only exist on a single planet type. The unique resources include Autotrophs ( Temperate planets), Felsic Magma ( Lava planets), and Reactive Gas ( Gas planets).
blocks.zh: 行星形态各异、大小不一，因而提供不同的材料。每颗行星提供五种资源，但有几种独特资源只存在于某一种行星上。独特资源包括自养生物（温和行星）、长英矿物岩浆（熔岩行星）和活性气体（气体行星）。

blocks.en: At first, you are limited to a single planet, so ideally you need to initially figure out what you're interested in harvesting and/or producing, pick the planet most appropriate for that activity, and then look for an example with the right resources in abundance. Note that planets in lower security systems are richer overall -- see Identifying valuable planets for some analysis. While you can colonize planets in unclaimed or NPC nullsec (even wormhole space!) you cannot colonize planets in territory claimed by an alliance other than your own.
blocks.zh: 起初你只能开发一颗行星，所以最好先想清楚你想采集和/或生产什么，选出最适合这项活动的行星类型，再去找一颗对应资源丰富的行星。注意，安全等级越低的星系，行星总体上越富饶——相关分析见识别有价值的行星。虽然你可以殖民无主或 NPC 00 区（甚至虫洞空间！）的行星，但你不能殖民被其他联盟（非你所在联盟）宣称主权的领地中的行星。

blocks.en: View in Planet Mode
blocks.zh: 以行星模式查看

blocks.en: To look for a planet you can use several different methods. You can fly to planets and click them, or be lazy and just select the planets from your overview. The Atlas can help you pick other systems, but it takes a few clicks to get anywhere. Either way, you'll want to use the "View in planet mode" option and get yourself a nice up-close view.
blocks.zh: 寻找行星有好几种方法。你可以飞到行星那里点击它，或者偷个懒直接在总览里选中行星。星图（Atlas）可以帮你挑选其他星系，但要点好几下才能到。无论哪种方式，你都需要使用“以行星模式查看”选项，近距离好好看一看。

blocks.en: You can also select planets from several other different views -- via your MapBrowser F11, for example. You can see a planet's overall resource abundance (and admire its visual appeal!) from anywhere, but the planet must be within your Remote Sensing skill range for you to perform a Scan operation for a specific resource (i.e. show its "heat" map). You can manage a planet you've already colonized from anywhere.
blocks.zh: 你还可以从其他几种视图中选择行星——比如通过 F11 打开的星图浏览器。你可以在任何地方查看行星的总体资源丰度（顺便欣赏一下它的美貌！），但要对某种资源执行扫描（即显示它的“热力”图），行星必须在你的遥测感应技术技能范围之内。已经殖民的行星则可以在任何地方管理。

blocks.en: Resources and Products
blocks.zh: 资源与产品

blocks.en: Main article: Planetary Commodities
blocks.zh: 主条目：行星商品

blocks.en: The items involved in Planetary Industry are known as Resources (extracted from Planets) and Products (produced from Resources or other Products on planets)
blocks.zh: 行星开发涉及的物品分为资源（从行星提取）和产品（在行星上用资源或其他产品生产）

blocks.en: Resources are considered Tier Zero (R0), at least in the context of this guide, and each level of processing increases the tier by one. You thus get Tier 1 products (P1) produced by Resources (R0), Tier 2 Products (P2) produced by combining two different P1s, and so on. Processing items from one tier to the next happens in a Processor on the surface of a planet, and each tier requires a different amount of different items. Processing can then be summarized as such, one level of processing is needed per column:
blocks.zh: 至少在本指南中，资源被视为第 0 级（R0），每加工一次等级加一。因此，资源（R0）生产出第 1 级产品（P1），两种不同的 P1 组合生产出第 2 级产品（P2），依此类推。从一个等级加工到下一个等级是在行星表面的处理设施中进行的，每个等级所需物品的种类和数量各不相同。加工过程可以总结如下，每一列需要一次加工：

en: Resources (R0)
Tier 1 Products (P1)
Tier 2 Products (P2)
Tier 3 Products (P3)
Tier 4 Products (P4)
zh: 资源（R0）
第 1 级产品（P1）
第 2 级产品（P2）
第 3 级产品（P3）
第 4 级产品（P4）

blocks.en: The actual Product combinations are performed as per "schematics" that are instructions for a Processor. Each schematic takes one to three items of varying tiers and quantities. You do not need to extract all the Resources you need on the same planet, nor process them to Tier 4. At any point, you can supplement your "Colonies" from the market or sell your goods there.
blocks.zh: 具体的产品组合按照“配方（schematic）”进行，配方就是处理设施的生产指令。每个配方需要一到三种不同等级、不同数量的物品。你不需要在同一颗行星上采集所需的全部资源，也不必一路加工到第 4 级。任何时候你都可以从市场补充“殖民地”所需的物资，或把商品卖到市场上。

blocks.en: Aside from leading to higher tiers of planetary Products, some PI goods can be used for T2 blueprints, Starbase / Sov structures, nanite paste, or POS fuel. For more information on the involved items, see Planetary Commodities. To find out how to get started looking for your initial Resources, read on!
blocks.zh: 除了用于生产更高等级的行星产品外，一些行星开发商品还可以用于 T2 蓝图、星堡 / 主权建筑、纳米体修复粘合剂或 POS 燃料。相关物品的更多信息请见行星商品。想知道如何开始寻找最初的资源，请继续往下读！

blocks.en: Planetary Buildings
blocks.zh: 行星建筑

blocks.en: Main article: Planetary buildings
blocks.zh: 主条目：行星建筑

blocks.en: To extract and produce resources and products you need buildings! Buildings match the planet they are constructed on, but players only need to worry about selecting the right type of command center, the rest are built in place on the planet and thus always of the right type. Each building beyond the Command Center costs a set amount of Powergrid (PG) and CPU. At a glance, the following structures exist:
blocks.zh: 要采集和生产资源和产品，你需要建筑！建筑与其所在的行星类型相匹配，但玩家只需操心选对指挥中心的类型，其余建筑都是在行星上就地建造的，所以类型总是对的。指挥中心以外的每座建筑都要消耗固定数量的能量栅格（PG）和 CPU。概括来说，有以下几种建筑：

en: Type
Description
Command Centers

The first building you must construct, deployed from orbit (or technically anywhere undocked in the system). Only a basic command center can be bought from the market. Command centers can be upgraded post-construction. Upgrades range from basic to elite, providing more CPU and Powergrid per level. Command Centers can store a small amount of material (500 m3) and offer a simple rocket-launch mechanism allowing the shipping of materials to orbit.
Extractor Control Units

Extractor Control Units (ECUs) allow the installation of extraction programs and the building of extraction heads. To make use of the extraction programs, you must select the resource type for all heads, a duration for the program (up to 14 days), and a route for the raw material to follow once extracted, lest it be lost. Additionally, you must manually initiate the extraction of a particular "seam" of the resource and submit your action before extraction begins.
Extractor Heads

Extraction of resources is done by extractor heads that are installable via the ECUs. The heads can be placed within the ECUs area and can be moved via drag and drop to resource hot-spots for a greater extraction amount.
Processors

These come in three different types, Basic (used to transform raw materials (P0) to processed materials (P1)), Advanced (used to either transform processed materials (P1) in refined commodities (P2) OR refined commodities (P2) in specialized commodities (P3)), and High Tech (used to transform specialized commodities (P3) in advanced commodities (P4)). The latter can only be built on barren or temperate planets.
Storage Facilities
About as simple as a planetary building goes, these hulks simply store materials or goods, potentially as part of a larger logistics system.
Launchpad

A building dedicated to moving materials and goods to and from the planet. This building operates in a similar way to the rocket launch function of the Command Center, but it benefits from its connection to a Cargo Link in orbit above the planet. From there, the owner can import and export goods, albeit at great expense.
Planetary Links

These can be thought of as railroads, connecting different structures. In addition to their construction (which has a base cost plus a distance cost), routes have to be defined using the links to route specific products across your planetary network. They have a finite capacity in m3 per hour and can be upgraded.
zh: 类型
说明
指挥中心
你必须建造的第一座建筑，从轨道上部署（严格来说，在星系内任何未停靠的位置都可以）。市场上只能买到基础型指挥中心。指挥中心建成后可以升级，从基础型到精英型，每一级都提供更多的 CPU 和能量栅格。指挥中心可以储存少量物资（500 m3），并提供简单的火箭发射功能，可以把物资送上轨道。
采集控制器
采集控制器（ECU）用于安装采集程序和建造采集头。要使用采集程序，你必须为所有采集头选择资源类型、设定程序时长（最长 14 天），并为采出的原材料设定路线，否则原材料会丢失。此外，你还必须手动开始采集某个资源“矿脉”，并提交操作后才会开始采集。
采集头
资源由通过采集控制器安装的采集头进行采集。采集头可以放置在采集控制器的范围内，并且可以拖放到资源热点处以提高采集量。
处理设施
分为三种：基础（把原材料（P0）加工成加工材料（P1））、高级（把加工材料（P1）加工成精炼商品（P2），或把精炼商品（P2）加工成特种商品（P3））和高科技（把特种商品（P3）加工成高级商品（P4））。高科技工厂只能建在贫瘠或温和行星上。
储藏设施
这是最简单的行星建筑了，这些大家伙只是用来储存材料或商品，可以作为更大物流系统的一部分。
发射平台
专门用于把材料和商品运进运出行星的建筑。它的工作方式类似于指挥中心的火箭发射功能，但它的优势在于与行星上空轨道中的货运链接相连。所有者可以通过它进出口商品，不过费用很高。
行星链
可以把它看作连接不同建筑的铁路。除了建造链路（费用为基础费用加距离费用）之外，还必须利用链路设定路线，才能让特定产品在你的行星网络中流转。链路每小时的运力（m3）有限，可以升级。

blocks.en: Setting Up a New Colony
blocks.zh: 建立新殖民地

blocks.en: For more details including a step-by-step pictorial guide of setting up a colony, see Setting up a planetary colony
blocks.zh: 更多细节（包括图文并茂的分步指南）请见建立行星殖民地

blocks.en: Planet Scanning
blocks.zh: 行星扫描

blocks.en: Example of a planet scan
blocks.zh: 行星扫描示例

blocks.en: After you've familiarized yourself a bit with planets and resources, you'll probably want to extract one from the other. Finding a planet that is simply abundant in a resource you want is only the first step. Now you need to find out where on the planet you'll want to place your stuff. To get started, get yourself into Planet Mode and make sure you're on the "Scan" tab. You should see the five available resources, a "NO FILTER" bar, and a colorful "heat" bar. Click any one resource and you'll get a heat map showing where on the planet that resource is abundant.
blocks.zh: 对行星和资源有了一定了解之后，你大概就想从行星上开采资源了。找到一颗你想要的资源很丰富的行星只是第一步，接下来你需要弄清楚要把设施放在行星上的什么位置。首先进入行星模式，确保你在“扫描”标签页。你应该能看到五种可用资源、一个“无过滤（NO FILTER）”条，以及一条彩色的“热力”条。点击任意一种资源，就会出现一张热力图，显示该资源在行星上哪些地方丰富。

blocks.en: The colored bar will allow you to modify the contrast of the heat map - as very rich or very poor resources may completely white out or appear invisible if your contrast is off. There are two triangles on the contrast bar. The left one will set the minimum resource abundance you want on the map (if you move it right poorer areas will disappear), and the right one will determine how rich a resource have to be to show as white (if you move it left poorer resources will show more distinctly). Ideally, you'll want a balance where you can see where the richer parts of the planet are. Remember that the colors are relative to the contrast bar setting - two white spots for the same resource on different planets with different contrast bar settings are not equal!
blocks.zh: 彩色条可以调整热力图的对比度——如果对比度没调好，非常丰富或非常贫乏的资源可能会完全显示为白色或根本看不见。对比度条上有两个三角形。左边的设定你希望在图上显示的最低资源丰度（往右移，较贫乏的区域就会消失），右边的决定资源要多丰富才显示为白色（往左移，较贫乏的资源会显示得更明显）。理想情况下，要调到能看出行星上哪些部分更富饶的平衡点。记住，颜色是相对于对比度条设置而言的——不同行星上、对比度条设置不同的同一种资源，两个白点并不相等！

blocks.en: You can leave a resource highlighted as you shift to the "Build" tab so you can more easily place an extractor on a rich spot (the white spot on this screenshot). To remove the heat overlay click the "NO FILTER" bar.
blocks.zh: 切换到“建造”标签页时，你可以保持某种资源的高亮显示，这样更容易把采集器放在富饶的地点（如截图中的白点）。要去掉热力图叠加层，点击“无过滤”条即可。

blocks.en: Deploying a Command Center
blocks.zh: 部署指挥中心

blocks.en: Placing a Plasma CC
blocks.zh: 放置等离子行星指挥中心

blocks.en: To get started on building stuff you need to first deploy a Command Center (CC) of the right type on your target planet.
blocks.zh: 要开始建造，首先需要在目标行星上部署一个类型正确的指挥中心（CC）。

blocks.en: Consider which resources you're targeting and where they are, placing your CC at some ideal spot near them (that is, if you plan to use it to export products instead of a Launchpad. The CC doesn't need to be connected to anything for you to build other structures). You'll usually end up placing your CC on the edge of one resource type (or a "pair" of resources that usually hang out together) with another resource type growing in intensity the further it gets from the white "peak" of the first. Whether or not resources are grouped, opposed to each other, live in bands, etc, depends on the planet type. See Planet for more details.
blocks.zh: 考虑你的目标资源是哪些、分布在哪里，把指挥中心放在它们附近的理想位置（前提是你打算用它而不是发射平台来出口产品。建造其他建筑并不需要连接指挥中心）。通常你最终会把指挥中心放在某种资源（或经常一起出现的一“对”资源）的边缘，而另一种资源离第一种资源的白色“峰值”越远就越浓。资源是聚在一起、彼此分开还是呈带状分布等，取决于行星类型。详情请见行星。

blocks.en: With the Build menu up, select the "Command Centers" menu and CCs of the specific size will light up, ready to be placed. If all are greyed out, make sure you put the CC in your cargo hold, that you are undocked, and that you are not at your colony cap (Interplanetary Consolidation skill). Drop the CC in the target spot and after it is placed be sure to click the "Submit" button that now appears in the UI to your left. Almost nothing in Planetary Industry is finalized until you click "Submit" and you can group some orders before submitting them (you might get a timer if you keep hitting Submit after every tiny change).
blocks.zh: 打开建造菜单，选择“指挥中心”菜单，对应尺寸的指挥中心就会亮起，可以放置了。如果全是灰色，请确认指挥中心在你的货柜里、你处于离站状态，并且还没达到殖民地数量上限（行星统筹管理学技能）。把指挥中心放到目标位置，放好后一定要点击左侧界面中出现的“提交（Submit）”按钮。在行星开发中，几乎所有操作在点击“提交”之前都不会生效，你也可以把一些指令归在一起再提交（如果每做一点小改动就点一次提交，可能会遇到冷却计时）。

blocks.en: After your CC has been deployed and you have submitted changes, further build options will become available. There seems to be a bug whereby sometimes these new options remain greyed out and are not selectable after deploying your CC. If this happens, simply leave planetary industry mode (click "exit") and then go back into it. Build options should now appear correctly allowing you to continue building your colony.
blocks.zh: 指挥中心部署完毕并提交更改后，更多建造选项就会出现。似乎有个 bug，有时部署指挥中心后这些新选项仍然是灰色、无法选择。如果遇到这种情况，只需退出行星开发模式（点击“退出”）再重新进入，建造选项应该就会正常显示，你就可以继续建设殖民地了。

blocks.en: You can upgrade your CC as needed once placed, up to your maximum Command Center Upgrades skill level.
blocks.zh: 指挥中心放置后可以根据需要升级，最高可升到你的指挥中心升级理论技能等级。

blocks.en: Surveying with an Extractor Control Unit
blocks.zh: 用采集控制器进行勘测

blocks.en: Surveying window
blocks.zh: 勘测窗口

blocks.en: Placing other buildings is just like placing a CC, though you'll want to keep consulting your Scan tab to make sure you get the Extractor Control Unit in an area that can reach out to rich spots. After you've placed an Extractor Control Unit (ECU), you have to Survey, which is distinct from Scanning. Surveying shows the actual numeric amounts of a single resource that can be extracted in a single spot under an Extractor Head. To perform a survey, simply select an Extractor and click the left-most button, highlighted in this screenshot.
blocks.zh: 放置其他建筑和放置指挥中心一样，不过你要不时查看扫描标签页，确保把采集控制器放在能够到富饶地点的区域。放置采集控制器（ECU）后，你需要进行勘测（Survey），这和扫描不同。勘测会显示单个采集头在某个地点能采集到的某种资源的具体数值。要进行勘测，只需选中采集器，点击最左边的按钮（截图中高亮的那个）。

blocks.en: You will be presented with another window (in the bottom half of the screenshot). First, select the type of resource you wish to extract. Then, move the "Extractor Area Size" slider until you have the desired program duration (how often you will have to come back to resurvey your extractors (ranges from 1 hour to 14 days)). Click on the first "Extractor Head Units" circle to create an Extractor Head. You can now move this new Extractor Head around within the radius of influence of the Extraction Control Unit (the grey circle you saw when placing the ECU) and watch the graph of extraction amount to see where a good deposit appears. Extractor Control Units can have up to 10 Extractor Heads. Each additional head consumes an amount of CPU (110) and Powergrid (550). The Extraction Area Size/Duration is a trade-off of varying total amount, cycle time (doubles at 25 hours (1d1h) to 30 min, 50 hours (2d2h) to 1hr, 4d4h to 2hr, 8d8h to 4hr.), per-cycle yield, and management requirements. If you have ample time to check on your Extractors often you can get a higher yield over shorter periods. If you do not want to check very often you can instead select long-term deposits so you won't need to babysit your extractors.
blocks.zh: 这时会弹出另一个窗口（截图下半部分）。首先选择你想采集的资源类型。然后拖动“采集区域大小”滑块，直到程序时长符合你的需要（即你多久要回来重新勘测一次采集器，范围从 1 小时到 14 天）。点击第一个“采集头单元”圆圈即可创建一个采集头。现在你可以在采集控制器的影响半径（放置 ECU 时看到的灰色圆圈）内移动这个新采集头，观察采集量图表，看哪里有好的矿藏。每个采集控制器最多可以有 10 个采集头。每增加一个采集头要消耗一定的 CPU（110）和能量栅格（550）。采集区域大小/时长需要在总量、周期时间（25 小时（1天1小时）时翻倍至 30 分钟，50 小时（2天2小时）时为 1 小时，4天4小时时为 2 小时，8天8小时时为 4 小时）、每周期产量和打理频率之间取舍。如果你有充足的时间经常查看采集器，就能在较短的周期内获得更高的产量。如果你不想经常查看，可以选择长期矿藏，这样就不用一直照看采集器。

blocks.en: After you select a deposit of your choice be sure to hit the "Install" button. This will forward you to the Product menu (second button on the ECU Window), from where you can route your extracted Resource somewhere. Keep in mind that when the cycle runs it course, you can rescan in the same place (with the same extractor) to begin the cycle again (or you can change the resource and move your Extractor Heads around again). But before you can route, you must link!
blocks.zh: 选定矿藏后，一定要点击“安装（Install）”按钮。这会把你带到产品菜单（ECU 窗口中的第二个按钮），在那里你可以把采集到的资源输送到其他地方。记住，周期结束后，你可以在同一地点（用同一个采集器）重新扫描，开始新的周期（也可以换一种资源，重新移动采集头）。不过在设定路线之前，你必须先建立链路！

blocks.en: Here is a video that shows how Extractor Heads are deployed (YouTube)
blocks.zh: 这里有一个演示如何部署采集头的视频（YouTube）

blocks.en: When you return to refresh your extraction programs, you may notice that the actual amount of materials extracted may be different (usually less) than the amount you expected. This inaccuracy may be mitigated by training Planetology and Advanced Planetology, but even at high skill levels the difference can be significant. To further reduce the inaccuracy, after you move your extractor heads and click start, DO NOT submit yet. Instead, click on the "Install Program" button again, and look at the updated extraction amount. If this is very different from what you expected, stop the program, move the heads, and try again until you have what you need.
blocks.zh: 当你回来刷新采集程序时，可能会发现实际采集到的材料数量和预期不同（通常更少）。训练行星学和高级行星学可以减小这种误差，但即使技能等级很高，差距也可能相当大。为了进一步减小误差，在移动采集头并点击开始后，先不要提交，而是再次点击“安装程序”按钮，查看更新后的采集量。如果和预期相差很大，就停止程序，移动采集头再试，直到满意为止。

blocks.en: Links and Routes
blocks.zh: 链路与路线

blocks.en: Creating a Link
blocks.zh: 创建链路

blocks.en: Links are used to connect buildings together so you can route materials around. Buildings cost money, Links do not. Both cost Powergrid and CPU, and the longer your links, the more PG and CPU they cost, limiting you from building other more interesting stuff. So short and few links are best, but sometimes you'll have to connect out to reach distant Extractors. The Planet Radius plays a significant role in PG cost of links so be mindful of this when placing them.
blocks.zh: 链路用于把建筑连接起来，以便输送材料。建筑要花钱，链路不用。但两者都要消耗能量栅格和 CPU，而且链路越长，消耗的能量栅格和 CPU 越多，会限制你建造其他更有用的东西。所以链路越短越少越好，但有时你不得不拉长链路去连接远处的采集器。行星半径对链路的能量栅格消耗影响很大，放置时要注意这一点。

blocks.en: There are multiple ways to get started making links, CTRL -clicking any building being the easiest. After your Link is started simply click (without CTRL) your target structure and your Link is ready to build next you hit "Submit". You do not need to connect every building to every other building, nor do you even need to start from or include your CC at all (generally a Launchpad is superior). Routes will connect through multiple "hops" (intervening structures) up to six links away. So you can make a few central "highway" links to connect distant clusters to each other.
blocks.zh: 开始建立链路有多种方法，最简单的是按住 CTRL 点击任意建筑。开始建立链路后，只需（不按 CTRL）点击目标建筑，链路就会在你下次点击“提交”时建成。你不需要把每座建筑都和其他所有建筑相连，甚至完全不需要从指挥中心出发或包含指挥中心（通常发射平台更好用）。路线最多可以经过六段链路，通过多个“中转”（中间的建筑）相连。所以你可以建几条中央“高速公路”链路，把远处的建筑群互相连接起来。

blocks.en: After a Link is planned (no need to hit "Submit" yet) you can finally make Routes! For a simple example you could route the Extractor to the CC in the screenshot, and then the CC to the Processor. Having started extracting earlier and installed a Schematic in the Processor you should be fully ready to Route next. Click the Extractor and go to the Products sub menu (this is where you'll be dropped off after Installing a Deposit, so it helps to prepare all your buildings and links before starting any Extractors), click the available Resource, select "Create Route", pick the CC, and hit "Create Route" again to finalize.
blocks.zh: 规划好链路后（还不需要点“提交”），终于可以设定路线了！举个简单的例子，你可以像截图中那样把采集器的产出输送到指挥中心，再从指挥中心输送到处理设施。如果你之前已经开始采集，并在处理设施中安装了配方，那么接下来就可以设定路线了。点击采集器，进入产品子菜单（安装矿藏后你会被直接带到这里，所以最好在启动任何采集器之前准备好所有建筑和链路），点击可用的资源，选择“创建路线”，选中指挥中心，再点一次“创建路线”完成设定。

blocks.en: At this point, your Extractor will route its output to your CC, where it'll build up until routed during production until the CC is full or the Extractor finishes its deposit. You'll want to click the main "Submit" button now to allow the Extractor to start working. Again, you might be tempted to route straight to the Processor, but resist! You'll waste precious material that way!
blocks.zh: 此时，采集器会把产出输送到指挥中心，这些资源会在指挥中心里积累，直到在生产中被输送出去，或者指挥中心装满、采集器采完矿藏为止。现在你应该点击主“提交”按钮，让采集器开始工作。同样，你可能会想直接输送到处理设施，但请忍住！那样会浪费宝贵的材料！

blocks.en: Next, click its Products sub menu and route from there to the Processor. Now when your processor is ready for more it will pull the resource for production, once you submit your changes. But wait! Lastly make a route the same way from the Processor back to your CC (or other storage). Like the extractor if it isn't stored it is lost. Finally hit "Submit" again and congratulations, you now have a working colony!
blocks.zh: 接下来，点击指挥中心的产品子菜单，从那里设定通往处理设施的路线。提交更改后，处理设施在准备好时就会拉取资源进行生产。但是等等！最后还要用同样的方法设定一条从处理设施回到指挥中心（或其他储藏设施）的路线。和采集器一样，产品如果没有被储存就会丢失。最后再点一次“提交”，恭喜，你现在拥有一个正常运转的殖民地了！

blocks.en: For more information on Links and Routing see Intraplanetary Logistics. To learn about what to do next, keep reading!
blocks.zh: 关于链路和路线的更多信息，请见行星内物流。想了解下一步该做什么，请继续往下读！

blocks.en: Links resource usage
blocks.zh: 链路的资源消耗

blocks.en: The scale of the infrastructure increases linearly with the radius of the planet. As such, the distance between two factories also increases linearly. After experimental testing:
blocks.zh: 基础设施的尺度随行星半径线性增加，因此两座工厂之间的距离也随之线性增加。经实验测试：

en: The Minimum Link distance (ml) on a planet of radius r is : ml(r) = 0,012008578×r (with ml and r in km). This the minimal distance between the center of two pins.
The PG cost of a link of distance l is : p(l) = 10+0.15×l
The CPU cost of a link of distance l is : c(l) = 15+0.2×l
zh: 半径为 r 的行星上，最小链路距离（ml）为：ml(r) = 0,012008578×r（ml 和 r 的单位均为 km）。这是两座建筑中心之间的最小距离。
长度为 l 的链路的能量栅格消耗为：p(l) = 10+0.15×l
长度为 l 的链路的 CPU 消耗为：c(l) = 15+0.2×l

blocks.en: Links usage of a plan
blocks.zh: 规划方案的链路消耗

blocks.en: We can then express the links of a planetary installation independently of the planet size, as the couple (n,k) with
blocks.zh: 这样，我们就可以不依赖行星大小来表示一个行星设施方案的链路，用一对数值 (n,k) 表示，其中

en: n the number of started links and
k the ratio of total length compared to minimum length, k=∑linklink.length/ml.
zh: n 为链路的条数，
k 为总长度与最小长度之比，k=∑linklink.length/ml。

blocks.en: n is the number of real links, while k is the number of minimal size segments the links run over.
blocks.zh: n 是实际链路的条数，而 k 是这些链路跨越的最小长度线段数。

en: if the infrastructures are only a launchpad and 6 high-tech production plants (HP), with the launchpad in the middle, we have 6 links and total 6 minimal segments
if we add 12 HP around the 6 existing

if we link them directly to the launchpad, half of them will require 2 segments (those just after another HP) and the other half will require 3 segments. Therefore the total number of links (n) is 18, the total length (k) is 6×1+6×2+6×3=28.4 minimal segments.
if we link them to the closest HP, then we add one minimal segment per new HP, total length is 18 so n=k=18.
zh: 如果设施只有一个发射平台和 6 座高科技工厂（HP），发射平台位于中间，那么共有 6 条链路，总计 6 个最小线段
如果在现有 6 座周围再加 12 座高科技工厂
如果把它们直接连到发射平台，其中一半需要 2 个线段（紧挨着另一座高科技工厂的那些），另一半需要 3 个线段。因此链路总数（n）为 18，总长度（k）为 6×1+6×2+6×3=28.4 个最小线段。
如果把它们连到最近的高科技工厂，那么每座新工厂只增加一个最小线段，总长度为 18，所以 n=k=18。

blocks.en: Plan consumption per planet
blocks.zh: 每颗行星的方案消耗

blocks.en: Once this is done, we have the cost of links on a planet depending on those values and r the radius of that planet
blocks.zh: 完成上述计算后，就能根据这些数值以及行星半径 r 得出该行星上链路的消耗

blocks.en: Then we can add the (constant) pins usage to those values.
blocks.zh: 然后再把（固定的）建筑消耗加到这些数值上即可。

blocks.en: Industry
blocks.zh: 工业

blocks.en: Lava Basic Processor with Schematics sub menu active
blocks.zh: 熔岩行星基础处理设施，配方子菜单处于激活状态

blocks.en: You now know how to get started with building stuff, and how to find and extract Resources. Good progress! Now we get to truly kick the industrial process into gear.
blocks.zh: 你现在已经知道如何开始建造，以及如何寻找和采集资源了。进展不错！现在我们要真正让工业流程运转起来。

blocks.en: The first step after extracting Resources is turning them into the first tier of Products - P1. Consult Planetary Commodities to find out what P1 item the resources you are extracting turn into, and then place a Basic Processor somewhere near your Extractor or some sort of storage - your CC has enough storage capacity for a starting colony. You can move your stuff straight from an Extractor to a Processor, but risk losing any "overflow" of material that backs up while the Processor is working. So always try to use storage first.
blocks.zh: 采集资源后的第一步，是把它们变成第一级产品——P1。查阅行星商品，找出你采集的资源能加工成哪种 P1 物品，然后在采集器或某种储藏设施附近放置一座基础处理设施——对于刚起步的殖民地，指挥中心的储存容量就够用了。你可以把资源直接从采集器送到处理设施，但处理设施工作期间积压的“溢出”材料可能会丢失。所以尽量先送进储藏设施。

blocks.en: Anyway, that's the next step, not yet! So get your Basic Processor built and look at the menu highlighted in the screenie - Schematics! For the displayed Processor we've selected and submitted an order for Bacteria, which takes 3000 units of Micro Organisms and turns them into 20 units of Bacteria. You must have a schematic selected to be able to route a Resource to your Processor, and only the exact ingredient(s) needed will be routable there.
blocks.zh: 不过那是下一步的事，先不急！先把基础处理设施建好，然后看看截图中高亮的菜单——配方！在图中这座处理设施上，我们选择并提交了细菌的生产指令，它会把 3000 单位微生物变成 20 单位细菌。必须先选定配方，才能把资源输送到处理设施，而且只有配方所需的原料才能输送过去。

blocks.en: Beyond turning Resources into P1 look at the Planetary Commodities page again for more combinations including those for Advanced Industry Facilities and High Tech Production Plants.
blocks.zh: 除了把资源加工成 P1 之外，请再看看行星商品页面，了解更多组合，包括高级工业设施和高科技工厂的配方。

blocks.en: Colony Management
blocks.zh: 殖民地管理

blocks.en: Viewing your Planets
blocks.zh: 查看你的行星

blocks.en: Main article: Colony management
blocks.zh: 主条目：殖民地管理

blocks.en: Now that you have built your first colony, you're on your way! After training Interplanetary Consolidation you can have multiple colonies, one per skill level, plus the initial one, and you may have to find them among the 67k planets in EVE again. Your current colony worlds can be found in the Science and Industry Tab, from which you can enter planet mode for each.
blocks.zh: 建好第一个殖民地之后，你就上路了！训练行星统筹管理学后，你可以拥有多个殖民地，每级技能多一个，再加上最初的那个；你可能还得在 EVE 的 6.7 万颗行星中再找几颗。你当前的殖民地行星可以在科研与工业标签页中找到，从那里可以进入各个行星的行星模式。

blocks.en: Producing the higher tier products on a single planet narrows down to where each P3 can only be produced from scratch (in other words, without importing goods) on a single planet type. P4 items all need multiple planet types, from two to five. This is where you need to start thinking about how deep you'd like to get into Planetary Industry. Look around for some blue or red pills and start talking about rabbit holes. Of course, a primary motivator is the title of the next section. For more information on how to deal with getting goods between colonies, see Interplanetary Logistics.
blocks.zh: 在单颗行星上生产更高等级的产品，会受到这样的限制：每种 P3 只能在某一种行星上从零开始生产（即不进口任何商品）。而 P4 物品都需要多种行星，从两种到五种不等。这时你就要开始考虑想在行星开发上投入多深了。找找蓝色或红色药丸，聊聊兔子洞吧。当然，最主要的动力就是下一节的标题。关于如何在殖民地之间转运商品，请见行星间物流。

blocks.en: In short, to build one unit of a P4 item you have to deal with two planets at least, launching your lower tier Products into orbit via a CC or Launchpad, then importing them via a Customs Office on another planet for further processing. You have to repeat this process multiple times for some P4s. Likely, your extra efforts(i.e. transporting materials between planets) devoted into this process will make the more involved products more profitable. But this depends. You need to carefully consider many factors, like the tax for every transportation, the market price for the components and the final product, the time consumed(Time is money, you should know) and so on. It's recommended that you do some calculation before you decide to produce any kind of products.
blocks.zh: 简而言之，要造出一单位 P4 物品，你至少要和两颗行星打交道：通过指挥中心或发射平台把低等级产品发射到轨道上，再通过另一颗行星的海关办公室进口，进行进一步加工。有些 P4 需要多次重复这个过程。在这个过程中额外付出的努力（即在行星之间运输材料），很可能会让更复杂的产品利润更高。但这要视情况而定。你需要仔细考虑很多因素，比如每次运输的税费、组件和最终产品的市场价格、花费的时间（你应该知道，时间就是金钱）等等。建议在决定生产任何产品之前先算一算。

blocks.en: With the new ECUs in Incursion it is no longer possible to do "perfect" P3 production on any planet—that is, continuously producing a P3 item at maximum output. You can extract one resource at a time, but no CC can support four ECUs and the factories needed to achieve continuous P3 production. This means if you are looking to maximize production, P3 production will always require at least 2 planets.
blocks.zh: 入侵资料片推出新的采集控制器后，任何行星都无法再实现“完美”的 P3 生产——即以最大产量持续生产 P3 物品。你可以一次采集一种资源，但没有哪个指挥中心能支撑四个采集控制器外加持续生产 P3 所需的工厂。这意味着如果你想让产量最大化，P3 生产总是至少需要 2 颗行星。

blocks.en: Profit!
blocks.zh: 赚钱！

blocks.en: A pending Launch from a command center
blocks.zh: 指挥中心的一次待发射

blocks.en: Assuming you'd just like to get on with it and make some money, we can certainly do that! Anything you make with PI can be sold on the market, though it is difficult to say what is going to be the most profitable. At a minimum, it seems reasonable to recommend processing your Resources into P1 goods before trying to sell them, as doing so shrinks the volume they take up to about 25% of the original. Even better would be going for P2 for another drop to 25% of the original, or a tiny 6.25% total of the volume in plain Resources.
blocks.zh: 如果你只是想尽快开始赚点钱，当然没问题！行星开发生产的任何东西都可以在市场上出售，不过很难说哪种利润最高。至少，比较合理的建议是先把资源加工成 P1 再出售，因为这样能把体积缩小到原来的约 25%。更好的是加工到 P2，体积再缩小到 P1 的 25%，即只有原始资源体积的 6.25%。

blocks.en: As mentioned above, it's usual to import and export items, but you need to pay taxes for both processes. The tax rates are preset at the planet's Customs Office and vary among systems with different security status.
blocks.zh: 如上所述，进出口物品很常见，但两者都要交税。税率由行星的海关办公室预先设定，并且因星系安全等级不同而有所差异。

blocks.en: Base Costs
blocks.zh: 基础费用

blocks.en: Commodities cost a percentage of a set taxable value per unit to export or import, based on the commodity's tier in the industry chain.
blocks.zh: 商品进出口的费用是一个固定计税价值的百分比，按单位计算，取决于商品在产业链中的等级。

en: Commodity level
Base Cost (ISK)

blocks.en: However, due to the above taxable values being per unit, and because of the compression that occurs as the PI product is refined to higher tiers, some tiers are cheaper to export/import than others:
blocks.zh: 不过，由于上述计税价值是按单位计算的，而且行星开发产品加工到更高等级时会发生压缩，所以某些等级的进出口费用比其他等级更便宜：

en: A 30-minute Basic Industrial Facility cycle uses 3,000 units of R0 to make 20 units of P1, for taxable values of (3,000*5=) 15,000 ISK before vs. (20*400=) 8,000 ISK after, a 47% reduction in taxable value, in addition to the volume being reduced to about 25% of the original.

A 1-hour P1 to P2 cycle uses a total of (2*40=) 80 units of P1 to make 5 units of P2, for taxable values of (80*400=) 32,000 ISK before vs. (5*7,200 =) 36,000 ISK after, an increase of 12.5% during this cycle but still a net reduction from R0. Due to planetary colony CPU/PG restrictions, production of P3 or higher products on a single planet isn't possible, so you'll have to export at this stage at the latest, usually. Volume compression is still about 4-fold, from 30.4m³ to 7.5m³.

A 1-hour P2 to P3 cycle uses 20 or 30 units of P2 to make 3 units of P3, for taxable values of (20*7,200=) 144,000 ISK / (30*7,200=) 216,000 ISK before vs. (3*60,000=) 180,000 ISK after, i.e. either an increase of 25% or a decrease of 16.7%. Volume reduction is to 60% or 40% respectively.
Finally, a P3 to P4 cycle uses either:
a total of 18 units (3 different types) of P3 to produce 1 unit of P4, for taxable values of (18*60,000=) 1,080,000 ISK before vs. 1,200,000 ISK after, or
a total of 12 units (2 different types of P3 and 40 units of P1 to produce 1 unit of P4, for taxable values of (12*60,000+40*400=) 736,000 ISK before vs. 1,200,000 ISK after
volume change is 108m³ or 87.2m³ respectively to 100m³, so not very significant.
zh: 基础工业设施一个 30 分钟的周期用 3,000 单位 R0 生产 20 单位 P1，计税价值从加工前的 (3,000*5=) 15,000 ISK 变为加工后的 (20*400=) 8,000 ISK，计税价值降低 47%，同时体积缩小到原来的约 25%。

一个 1 小时的 P1 到 P2 周期总共用 (2*40=) 80 单位 P1 生产 5 单位 P2，计税价值从加工前的 (80*400=) 32,000 ISK 变为加工后的 (5*7,200 =) 36,000 ISK，这个周期增加了 12.5%，但相比 R0 仍是净减少。由于行星殖民地的 CPU/能量栅格限制，无法在单颗行星上生产 P3 或更高等级的产品，所以通常最迟在这个阶段就得出口。体积压缩仍约为 4 倍，从 30.4m³ 降到 7.5m³。
一个 1 小时的 P2 到 P3 周期用 20 或 30 单位 P2 生产 3 单位 P3，计税价值从加工前的 (20*7,200=) 144,000 ISK / (30*7,200=) 216,000 ISK 变为加工后的 (3*60,000=) 180,000 ISK，即增加 25% 或减少 16.7%。体积分别缩小到 60% 或 40%。
最后，P3 到 P4 的周期有两种情况：
总共用 18 单位（3 种不同的）P3 生产 1 单位 P4，计税价值从加工前的 (18*60,000=) 1,080,000 ISK 变为加工后的 1,200,000 ISK，或者
总共用 12 单位（2 种不同的）P3 加 40 单位 P1 生产 1 单位 P4，计税价值从加工前的 (12*60,000+40*400=) 736,000 ISK 变为加工后的 1,200,000 ISK
体积分别从 108m³ 或 87.2m³ 变为 100m³，变化不大。

blocks.en: Note that if you want to produce P3 or P4, you have to pay the potentially higher (relative to the previous stage) taxes, but this information should help you decide e.g. which Planetary Industry products to make at higher-tax locations.
blocks.zh: 注意，如果你想生产 P3 或 P4，就必须支付可能（相对于上一阶段）更高的税费，不过这些信息可以帮你决定，比如在高税率的地方生产哪些行星开发产品。

blocks.en: However, perhaps the most important lesson of the above taxable value calculations is that even with a purely resource-extracting planet, refining from R0 to P1 is worth it not just for the significantly reduced hauling needs, but also for significantly lower taxes. When producing up to the P2 stage, producing 1 type of P2 per planet and only exporting at that stage is probably the cheapest option overall, compared to also having to buy both an export and import tax on the P1. However, when producing P3 or higher goods, where you always need to import something in any case, one should consider whether it might be feasible to export at the P1 stage on the initial resource production planets (or buy P1 from the market) and import the P1 to be refined to higher-tier goods.
blocks.zh: 不过，从上面的计税价值计算中得出的最重要的一课也许是：即使是纯粹采集资源的行星，把 R0 加工成 P1 也是值得的，这不仅能大大减少运输量，还能大大降低税费。如果只生产到 P2 阶段，每颗行星生产 1 种 P2 并只在这个阶段出口，总体上可能是最便宜的选择，比 P1 还要交一次出口税和一次进口税要划算。不过，在生产 P3 或更高等级商品时，反正总要进口一些东西，这时就应该考虑：是否可以在最初的资源生产行星上以 P1 形式出口（或从市场购买 P1），再把 P1 进口去加工成更高等级的商品。

blocks.en: High Sec
blocks.zh: 高安

blocks.en: High-sec Player-Owned Customs Offices(POCO) have a 10% NPC tax rate, in addition to the tax rate set by the POCO owner, which can vary according to your standings towards the owning corp. Corporations who own Customs Offices can charge as much as they please.
blocks.zh: 高安的玩家海关办公室（POCO）有 10% 的 NPC 税率，另外还有 POCO 所有者设定的税率，这部分可能因你对所有者军团的声望而异。拥有海关办公室的军团想收多少税都可以。

blocks.en: The NPC portion of the tax rate can be reduced by the Customs Code Expertise skill added with Rubicon.
blocks.zh: 税率中的 NPC 部分可以通过卢比肯（Rubicon）资料片加入的海关操作专业理论技能降低。

blocks.en: The tax rate show in the description of a specific high-sec Customs Office is equal to:
blocks.zh: 某个高安海关办公室说明中显示的税率等于：

blocks.en: 10%+%Player tax−(1%×Custom Code Expertise level)
blocks.zh: 10%+%玩家税率−(1%×海关操作专业理论等级)

blocks.en: Low Sec, Null Sec, and Wormhole Space
blocks.zh: 低安、00 区和虫洞空间

blocks.en: NPC-owned Customs Offices outside of high-sec (if any remain, which is unlikely) charge 17%. That rate cannot be reduced (The skill Customs Code Expertise does not affect this). For Player-Owned Customs Offices outside of high-sec, there is no NPC tax component, so the whole tax rate is exactly what the owning corp sets it at. Again, Customs Code Expertise does not affect these rates.
blocks.zh: 高安以外的 NPC 海关办公室（如果还有的话，可能性不大）收取 17% 的税。这个税率无法降低（海关操作专业理论技能对其无效）。高安以外的玩家海关办公室没有 NPC 税部分，所以全部税率完全由所有者军团设定。同样，海关操作专业理论对这些税率无效。

blocks.en: Import/Export formulas
blocks.zh: 进出口公式

blocks.en: Export fee=Base cost×tax rate(×1.5if launched via CC)
blocks.zh: 出口费用=基础费用×税率(×1.5若通过指挥中心发射)

blocks.en: Import fee=Base cost×tax rate×0.5
blocks.zh: 进口费用=基础费用×税率×0.5

blocks.en: Importing that unit of Biomass to a high-sec factory planet will cost at minimum an additional 20 ISK (400 * (10% + % Player Tax) * 0.5 )
blocks.zh: 把那一单位生物质进口到高安的工厂行星，至少还要额外花费 20 ISK（400 * (10% + % 玩家税率) * 0.5）

blocks.en: Transport: Two options
blocks.zh: 运输：两种选择

blocks.en: You have two options for getting goods off your planet, either launching a simple (and small) rocket from your CC or placing a Launchpad on your colony (rather expensive) and using it to interact with an orbiting Customs Office.
blocks.zh: 把商品运离行星有两种选择：从指挥中心发射一枚简单（且小）的火箭，或者在殖民地上放置一座发射平台（相当贵），用它与轨道上的海关办公室交互。

blocks.en: Launchpad
blocks.zh: 发射平台

blocks.en: A Launchpad has the greater cost up front but is generally superior to Command Centre launches.
blocks.zh: 发射平台的前期成本更高，但总体上优于指挥中心发射。

blocks.en: A Launchpad exports to an orbiting Customs Office and the export taxes may be less than the Command Centre export tax (in High Sec the Command Centre export tax is 15% - 1.5 times the NPC tax rate) depending on the Customs Office tax rate. A Launchpad can also launch far larger amounts and is the only way to import items onto a planet. Command Centre launches also have a cooldown period.
blocks.zh: 发射平台把物品出口到轨道上的海关办公室，出口税可能比指挥中心的出口税更低（在高安，指挥中心出口税为 15%，即 NPC 税率的 1.5 倍），具体取决于海关办公室的税率。发射平台一次能发射的量也大得多，而且是把物品进口到行星上的唯一途径。指挥中心发射还有冷却时间。

blocks.en: Keep in mind that you are charged 50% of the export tax to import items from the Customs Office to your Launchpad. Consider the costs carefully before setting up a multi-planet production chain. Players can own High Sec Customs Offices and set any tax rate they wish, if you have a large factory system making Level 4 items and need to import and export this also needs to be kept in mind.
blocks.zh: 记住，从海关办公室把物品进口到发射平台，要收取出口税的 50%。在建立多行星生产链之前，要仔细考虑成本。玩家可以拥有高安海关办公室并随意设定税率，如果你有一个生产 4 级物品的大型工厂系统，需要进出口，也要考虑到这一点。

blocks.en: Command Center
blocks.zh: 指挥中心

blocks.en: Sometimes your Customs Office may be camped by pirates or you are simply unwilling to pay the dramatic tax (like 80% or more). And when you start doing PI, the high requirement of a Launchpad may make you unwilling to build one because it reduces the CPU (3,600tf per launchpad) available for production facilities. At this time you can use your Command Center to get your commodities off your planet. The screen capture here shows the easier option - a launch prepared from your CC, accessed via the rocket-looking icon. Simply click the items in your storage to add them to the pending launch and when you're happy click the nice "Go for launch" button (not to be mistaken for the more yummy "Go for lunch" button) and the contents of the launch will end up in a jet can orbiting the planet at a random spot. You get an entry in your planetary production window under launches for its location. This location can be warped to pick up the items. There is also a timer when the timer ends your production is lost - don't worry too much, it can last several days before pickup!
blocks.zh: 有时你的海关办公室可能被海盗蹲守，或者你实在不愿意交那惊人的税（比如 80% 甚至更高）。而且刚开始做行星开发时，发射平台的高要求可能让你不愿意建，因为它会减少生产设施可用的 CPU（每座发射平台 3,600tf）。这时你可以用指挥中心把商品运离行星。这里的截图展示的是更简单的方式——通过形似火箭的图标打开指挥中心的发射准备界面。只需点击储存中的物品，把它们加入待发射列表，满意后点击漂亮的“发射（Go for launch）”按钮（别和更好吃的“去吃午饭（Go for lunch）”按钮搞混了），发射的内容就会出现在环绕行星某个随机位置的一个抛弃货柜里。在行星生产窗口的发射记录下，你会看到一条记录它位置的条目，可以跃迁到那里取货。还有一个计时器，计时结束时你的产品就会丢失——不用太担心，它可以保留好几天！

blocks.en: After you pick up your items you can simply go sell them on the market like you would anything else. Easy money! The hard part is picking what Commodity to focus on.
blocks.zh: 取到物品后，你就可以像卖其他东西一样把它们拿到市场上出售。轻松赚钱！难的是选择专攻哪种商品。

blocks.en: Term list
blocks.zh: 术语表

blocks.en: The following terms are defined here in an attempt to make them widely used and not ambiguous with similar terms within the context of Planetary Industry. Note that some terms defined here may have alternative meanings outside of PI - such as Scan, which outside PI can refer to your ship's scanning abilities, unrelated to planets.
blocks.zh: 这里定义了以下术语，希望它们能被广泛使用，并避免与行星开发语境中相近的术语混淆。注意，这里定义的一些术语在行星开发之外可能有其他含义——比如“扫描”，在行星开发之外可以指你舰船的扫描能力，与行星无关。

blocks.en: Planet Mode
blocks.zh: 行星模式（Planet Mode）

blocks.en: the view you enter to interact with a planet
blocks.zh: 与行星交互时进入的视图

blocks.en: Scan
blocks.zh: 扫描（Scan）

blocks.en: the act of searching a planet for a particular resource (brings up a heat map)
blocks.zh: 在行星上搜寻某种特定资源的操作（会调出热力图）

blocks.en: Survey
blocks.zh: 勘测（Survey）

blocks.en: the act of locating deposits available to an extractor
blocks.zh: 为采集器定位可用矿藏的操作

blocks.en: Deposit
blocks.zh: 矿藏（Deposit）

blocks.en: a "seam" of minerals or other resources that is exploitable by an extractor
blocks.zh: 可供采集器开采的矿物或其他资源的“矿脉”

blocks.en: Resources
blocks.zh: 资源（Resources）

blocks.en: the various raw materials you can extract from planets.
blocks.zh: 可以从行星上采集的各种原材料。

blocks.en: Products
blocks.zh: 产品（Products）

blocks.en: actual items manufactured from Resources or other Products (tier 1 and beyond)
blocks.zh: 由资源或其他产品制造出来的实际物品（第 1 级及以上）

blocks.en: Commodities
blocks.zh: 商品（Commodities）

blocks.en: - any PI material (Resources + Products)
blocks.zh: - 任何行星开发材料（资源 + 产品）

blocks.zh: 等级（P0、P1 等）

blocks.zh: - 原材料（资源）为 0 级，之后每一级都是一组新的产品，每升一级需要经过一道制造工序

blocks.en: Tips
blocks.zh: 技巧

en: Starting off small can help, check the local region for prices and make enough to cover your costs. Building large installations that cost a lot to start with can place you worse off. With something as new and as detailed as PI, playing it safe is usually your best bet.
zh: 从小规模起步会有帮助，查看本地星域的价格，生产足以覆盖成本的量即可。一开始就建造成本高昂的大型设施，可能会让你得不偿失。对于行星开发这样新颖又复杂的玩法，稳妥行事通常是最好的选择。

en: Planets may be managed from anywhere using the science and industry tool and clicking on the Planets tab.
zh: 通过科研与工业工具并点击“行星”标签页，可以在任何地方管理行星。

en: To open the planet over view from anywhere Press F11 and in the side panel you can use the bottom window to select planet view by right clicking the menu box in the left corner.
By switching solar systems or regions in the above boxes you can scan planets in regions as far as your abilities allow.
zh: 要在任何地方打开行星概览，按 F11，在侧边栏中可以用底部窗口，右键左上角的菜单框来选择行星视图。
在上面的框中切换星系或星域，就能在你能力允许的范围内扫描各星域的行星。

en: In the solar system box you can use show info under each solar system and look at orbital bodies to get a list of planet type rather than look at them one at a time. You can also view planet directly from the list.
zh: 在星系框中，你可以对每个星系使用“显示信息”并查看轨道天体，获得行星类型列表，而不必一颗一颗地看。也可以直接从列表中查看行星。

en: You can deploy Command Centers while docked, but you must be in the same system as the planet, and the command center must be in your ship's hold.
zh: 你可以在停靠状态下部署指挥中心，但必须和行星在同一个星系，而且指挥中心必须在你舰船的货柜中。

en: https://www.eve-icsc.com/jumptools/jumpplanner.php use this link you calculate LY range to see what systems will be in range based on your Remote Sensing skill level. It will help with planning.
zh: https://www.eve-icsc.com/jumptools/jumpplanner.php 用这个链接计算光年范围，看看根据你的遥测感应技术技能等级，哪些星系在范围内。这有助于做规划。

en: Until you click the "submit" button, no actual changes are made to your colony. This allows you to experiment with different setups without committing to them (for example arranging buildings and links to make best use of the available powergrid and CPU). If you do not want to make your changes, simply click "cancel" and the colony will revert back to how it was.
zh: 在你点击“提交”按钮之前，殖民地不会发生任何实际变化。这让你可以尝试不同的布局而不必真正执行（比如调整建筑和链路的位置，以充分利用可用的能量栅格和 CPU）。如果不想保留更改，只需点击“取消”，殖民地就会恢复原样。

en: Double-clicking various structures makes starting or adjusting production much faster. When you doubleclick factory it opens the schematics list, doubleclicking a schematic of your choosing opens the routing screen where you can doubleclick the product to enable the create route function and finally doubleclick the destination to create the route. Doubleclicking a silo opens also the routing screen.
zh: 双击各种建筑可以更快地开始或调整生产。双击工厂会打开配方列表，双击你选择的配方会打开路线界面，在那里双击产品可以启用创建路线功能，最后双击目的地即可创建路线。双击储藏仓也会打开路线界面。

en: At schematics selection screen you can press the first letter of the schematic you are looking for to instantly move the selection window to the products starting with the letter you just pressed (need to click on the window first to activate the function).
zh: 在配方选择界面，你可以按下目标配方的首字母，选择窗口会立即跳到以该字母开头的产品（需要先点击一下窗口来激活这个功能）。

blocks.en: Power Efficient Harvesting
blocks.zh: 高能效采集

blocks.en: A Coolant Producing Gas Planet
blocks.zh: 一颗生产冷却剂的气体行星

blocks.en: You will want to maximize efficiency to maximize your profits. The layout of your facilities will help save power grid through optimization of your planetary links. This image represents an efficient method of resource harvesting, with some industry facilities.
blocks.zh: 你会希望把效率最大化，以实现利润最大化。通过优化行星链路，合理的设施布局可以节省能量栅格。这张图展示了一种高效的资源采集方式，还附带一些工业设施。

blocks.en: On this Gas planet, 2 extractors feed into warehouses which buffer excess resources for basic industry facilities. 4 basic industry facilities produce water and electrolytes, which are then stored in the launchpad until 2 advanced industry facilities produce coolant. The coolant will eventually fill the launchpad, ready to fuel a POS or be shipped to an industry intensive planet in Organic Mortar Applicators.
blocks.zh: 在这颗气体行星上，2 个采集器把资源送进仓库，仓库为基础工业设施缓存多余的资源。4 座基础工业设施生产水和电解物，然后储存在发射平台中，直到 2 座高级工业设施把它们加工成冷却剂。冷却剂最终会装满发射平台，可以用作 POS 燃料，或者运到工业密集型行星上，制成有机砂浆喷注器。

blocks.en: Having several basic harvesting planets and a few high sec industrial planets, a pilot can make valuable goods that are space efficient, increasing the isk you make for the haul you take.
blocks.zh: 拥有几颗基础采集行星和几颗高安工业行星，飞行员就能生产出节省空间的高价值商品，提高每一趟运输赚到的 ISK。

blocks.en: Using Poor Worlds (High Security Space)
blocks.zh: 利用贫瘠星球（高安）

blocks.en: A Factory for P2 assembly
blocks.zh: 一座组装 P2 的工厂

blocks.en: Some people find the clicking excessive in PI while others aren't impressed with the income they can gain using local resources. There is another way to utilize PI for reasonable income.
blocks.zh: 有些人觉得行星开发要点的东西太多，另一些人则对利用本地资源所能获得的收入不太满意。还有另一种利用行星开发获得可观收入的方法。

blocks.en: For example of the solution I offer the Factory World.
blocks.zh: 作为解决方案的例子，我推荐工厂星球。

blocks.en: Using 20 Advanced Processors and 2 Launchpads it processes 28,800 total (2 or more varieties) P1 tier commodities into P2 tier commodities in 18 hours. It is as click intensive as fueling a POS.
blocks.zh: 它使用 20 座高级处理设施和 2 座发射平台，在 18 小时内把总共 28,800 单位（2 种或以上）P1 级商品加工成 P2 级商品。操作量和给 POS 加燃料差不多。

blocks.en: A quick spreadsheet or hand written notes about the sell/buy prices of the commodities in question are required for profit, the equation looks like:
blocks.zh: 要想盈利，需要用一张简单的电子表格或手写笔记记录相关商品的买卖价格，计算公式如下：

blocks.en: P2 (buy)−((P1 a (Sell)+P1 b (Sell))×8)−(Import/Export Tax of1.5×tax rate)=Profit per unit
blocks.zh: P2 (买入价)−((P1 a (卖出价)+P1 b (卖出价))×8)−(进出口税1.5×税率)=每单位利润

blocks.en: Advanced Processors can also be used to produce P3 products from P1 and P2 commodities. For these, the calculations become somewhat more complicated, because the taxes vary depending on whether the ingredients are P1 or P2.
blocks.zh: 高级处理设施也可以用 P1 和 P2 商品生产 P3 产品。这种情况下计算会复杂一些，因为税费会因原料是 P1 还是 P2 而不同。

blocks.en: Planetary Industry During War (Uni only!)
blocks.zh: 战争期间的行星开发（仅限 Uni！）

blocks.en: There are things you can still do with planets while the Uni is at war:
blocks.zh: Uni 处于战争状态时，你仍然可以对行星做这些事：

en: Day-to-Day Management: Resurvey your extractors, route products in your colony
Build/tear-down non-Command Center structures

Launch containers from your CC if you want, if you have no other storage (they'll last 5 days in orbit - difficult but maybe not impossible to pick up via alt + directional scanner, but certainly silly high effort to income)
Decommission your entire colony
For extended war periods, you may want to consider adding additional storage to planets.
zh: 日常管理：重新勘测采集器，在殖民地内设定产品路线
建造/拆除指挥中心以外的建筑
如果没有其他储存空间，愿意的话可以从指挥中心发射货柜（它们会在轨道上保留 5 天——用小号加定向扫描去取虽然困难但也许并非不可能，不过投入产出比肯定低得离谱）
拆除整个殖民地
如果战争时间较长，可以考虑在行星上增加额外的储藏设施。

blocks.en: These are things you can do while the Uni is at war but you must take extreme precautions with:
blocks.zh: Uni 处于战争状态时，以下事情可以做，但必须采取极其谨慎的预防措施：

en: Deploy Command Center on a new planet
Export/Import to/from orbital Customs Centers (requires you to be in space in the same system)
Pick up launch containers (yourself)
Fly to within (skill-based) light years to scan for deposits
zh: 在新行星上部署指挥中心
与轨道上的海关办公室进行进出口（需要你身处同一星系的太空中）
（亲自）拾取发射的货柜
飞到（取决于技能的）光年范围内扫描矿藏

blocks.en: Consider Creating a Planetary Industry Alt.
blocks.zh: 可以考虑创建一个行星开发小号。

blocks.en: War targets love to watch for lone Unistas who are vulnerable and solo doing activities such as PI in space. Take all precautions and don't risk an embarrassing industrial or other ship loss. Make sure you conduct these activities when war targets are not active or at least active near where you are doing PI activities. Use alts whenever possible.
blocks.zh: 战争目标最喜欢盯着那些落单、易受攻击、独自在太空中做行星开发之类活动的 Uni 成员。做好一切预防措施，别冒险丢掉工业舰或其他舰船，闹出尴尬。确保在战争目标不活跃时进行这些活动，至少要在他们不在你做行星开发的地方附近活跃时进行。尽可能使用小号。

blocks.en: Note that if you have the skill to fly a blockade runner and you take the time to bookmark a tactical at 200 km or so from your Custom Center, it is possible to do PI fairly safely. Simply fly cloaked to your tactical, use d-scan to make sure no one is nearby, and if clear warp to the Custom Center. You must be uncloaked to access the Custom Center, but you can move stuff between the surface and the Custom Center even when cloaked provided you are in the same system.
blocks.zh: 注意，如果你有驾驶偷运舰的技能，并花点时间在距离海关办公室 200 km 左右的地方存一个战术书签，就能相当安全地进行行星开发。只需隐形飞到战术书签，用定向扫描确认附近没有人，如果安全就跃迁到海关办公室。访问海关办公室时必须解除隐形，但只要你在同一个星系，即使处于隐形状态也可以在行星表面和海关办公室之间转移物品。
